formats.name: Cheap versus premium, same test
formats.title_shape: Cheap vs Expensive ___: Is It Worth It?

formats.episode_arc: Unbox both together; set three relevant criteria; test in the same framing; reveal actual receipts; decide what he would keep.

formats.name: One day, one new skill
formats.promise: Start with an honest failed baseline and finish with one visible, modest skill target.
formats.retention_engine: Baseline failure → small milestone → plateau → one technique change → final uninterrupted attempt.
formats.episode_arc: Define success before practice; show the baseline; film three checkpoints; show the hardest setback; finish on a timed or counted attempt.
formats.solo_method: Niz teaches himself from written or prerecorded resources and films with a locked wide shot. A 24-hour calendar window allows sleep and ordinary breaks; only 2–4 hours of practice are planned.
formats.edit_rule: Keep a failed final attempt if that is the result. Do not title the episode as mastery; separate best practice clips from the final scored attempt.
